unresolved: Configured automation/workflow destinations and templates are runtime data, so their exact raw/targets cannot be enumerated statically. Paths identify those open boundaries; no MCP write tool remains unclassified.
The canaries exercise immediate output and one explicit crawl. They do not drain all conditional plugin jobs or prove safety of arbitrary configured automation/theme code.

excluded_candidates.reason: Requires opts[:blog_id]; MCP ToolHelpers only permits its explicit create fields and does not forward blog_id.
Separate board action invokes it; TopicSync called by MCP-reachable hooks synchronizes cards and does not call ConstraintFixer.
MCP UpdateUser uses username as the target selector and does not allow username changes in its mutation field set.
